newsitem.title: USA: ARCO takes all June crude nominations on Line 63.
newsitem.headline: ARCO takes all June crude nominations on Line 63.

text.p: ARCO Pipeline Co will not proration June nominations on its California Line 63 crude pipeline running from oil fields in the southern Central Valley south to Los Angeles-area refinery, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We'll take all the oil nominated," ARCO Pipeline spokesman John Thom said.
He declined to disclose volumes nominated for June, citing company policy.

June marks the third straight month there was no prorationing on the 118-mile line, which is rated to carry 120,000 barrels per day (bpd) of light crude but more typically carries about 105,000 to 110,000 bpd of a mix of light and heavy crudes.
ARCO Pipeline is a unit of Atlantic Richfield Co.
